title: Nuclei Isolation from Human Skeletal Muscle
author: Hongbo Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t68erhw

steps.title: Prepare Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the required buffers for each human sample.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 5ml Buffer A
Prepare 10ml Buffer B

steps.title: Prepare Muscle Tissue
steps.instruction: Isolate and clean the muscle tissue from the hind limb.

substeps.instruction: Dissect all hind limb muscles and place in a 35/60mm tissue culture dish with 0.5ml PBS
Remove fat from muscle using scissors
Wash the muscle with 1X PBS twice

steps.title: Mechanically Chop Tissue
steps.instruction: Mince the muscle tissue into small pieces.

substeps.instruction: Mechanically chop the muscle into 1mm pieces with a razor
Mix the red and white muscles

steps.title: First Homogenization
steps.instruction: Perform initial tissue grinding using a loose pestle.

substeps.instruction: Rinse a 7 ml dounce homogenizer with MiliQ water
Transfer 0.3g of mashed muscle into the 7 ml dounce homogenizer with 3ml of Buffer A using a razor
Grind the tissue on ice for 50 strokes with loose Pestle A (clearance 0.114 mm), avoiding bubbles and without twisting the pestle

steps.title: First Filtration and Wash
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate and collect it in a falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Filter the mixture through a 100micron strainer into a 50ml falcon tube
Rinse the dounce homogenizer with 1ml Buffer A and wash through the cell strainer into the 50ml falcon tube
Repeat the washing with another 750ul of Buffer A (final volume should be ±4.75ml)

steps.title: Detergent Treatment
steps.instruction: Add Triton X-100 to the tissue homogenate.

substeps.instruction: Add 250ul of Triton X-100 (10%) to the homogenate to achieve a final concentration of 0.5%
Mix the solution gently by pipetting

steps.title: Second Homogenization
steps.instruction: Perform secondary grinding using a tight pestle.

substeps.instruction: Wash the 7 ml dounce homogenizer with MiliQ water
Place the tissue homogenate back into the cleaned dounce homogenizer
Grind the mixture for an additional 50 strokes with tight Pestle B (clearance 0.076mm)

steps.title: Second Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the mixture through a finer strainer.

substeps.instruction: Filter the mixture through a 40micron strainer
Leave bubbles in the strainer and collect only the filtered solution accumulated at the bottom

steps.title: Initial Nuclei Pellet Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate to isolate the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the tissue filtrate at 3000 x g for 5min at 4 degrees
Remove the supernatant entirely
Re-suspend the nuclei pellet in 1ml Buffer B and transfer to a 1.5ml Eppendorf tube

steps.title: Percoll Gradient Separation
steps.instruction: Purify nuclei using a Percoll solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 4 new Eppendorf tubes, adding 475 ul of Buffer B into each
Gently mix the nuclei suspension by pipetting
Add 225 ul of nuclei suspension and 300 ul of Percoll solution into each of the 4 tubes to create a 27% Percoll-nuclei solution; mix by pipetting
Centrifuge the tubes at 20,000 x g for 15 minutes at 4 degrees
Remove the supernatant and keep only the nuclei layer (pellet), noting the tube orientation

steps.title: Nuclei Pooling and Washing
steps.instruction: Combine and wash the purified nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Re-suspend the nuclear layer from each tube into 200ul of Buffer B
Pool the nuclei suspensions from the 4 tubes into one tube
Spin down the nuclei at 2500 x g for 3 minutes at 4C
Remove the supernatant and add 1ml of buffer B
Gently disperse the pellet with pipetting and spin down again at 2500 x g for 3 minutes at 4C

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Quantification
steps.instruction: Prepare the final nuclei suspension and check viability.

substeps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and re-suspend the nuclei in 50-200 ul of Buffer B (adjust volume according to pellet size)
Stain the intact nuclei using trypan blue (50:50) and quantify by counting with a hemocytometer

steps.title: Equipment Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean and store the homogenization equipment.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pestles and homogenizers with water-80% EtOH
Leave to dry out
